title: More ways to use the text API
summary:
New text models arrived while model access, request accounting, and error handling got a careful tune-up.

The nectar tier gained text-only `gpt5` with tool support, and anonymous users gained `roblox-rp`, a roleplay model that routes requests to either Llama 3 8B Instruct or Mistral Small 2402. `gpt-5-nano` was added, then removed from the model list the following day, so it is not presented as a current option.

Text-request events now record timing, status, model selection, token usage, and moderation results. Error handling also improved: the service catches failures while sending error responses, and the OpenAI-compatible client supplies better model context and diagnostics.

The Special Bee request path was removed in favor of tier-based guidance across the dashboard, docs, schemas, and the `gpt-image-1` access error. Model-list adjustments included a move for `openai-large` from flower to seed and back to flower, a lower input limit of 5,000 characters, and removal of `claudyclaude`. No change to tier eligibility or API request handling was reported with the guidance update.

EasyGen joined the chat projects list with prompt-to-Mermaid diagrams, instant previews, and editable source. Pollix AI, a multilingual Telegram assistant with image understanding, joined the project list and social bots catalog.
